purpose: Consolidate the already-completed target-discovery qualification work so historical evidence, current authority, dependencies and remaining gates are not confused or repeated.

qualification_semantics.historical_evidence: May constrain interpretation and avoid repeated work but does not by itself restore current authority after the corrected-substrate defect.
qualification_semantics.current_authority: Requires exact current qualifying evidence under the prospectively frozen gate system.
qualification_semantics.not_estimable: Never silently converted to FAIL or PASS.
qualification_semantics.portfolio_rule: Multiple blocks may remain qualified if complementary; no rule forces a single target winner.
qualification_semantics.rare_common_rule: Rare/common biology preservation is one cross-cutting target-quality property, not a separate target lane.

historical_support: Real-TRAIN global-state work established a biologically interpretable shared-state program with donor/operator-aware auditing.
Stage81A3/A3R and foundation work supplied shared-state recurrence, support, stability and observation-operator concepts.
Historical relational work also demonstrates that nontrivial shared cross-view geometry exists, but relational evidence is not required for C1 by definition.
already_qualified_infrastructure: G1-G12 + S1-S3 gate inheritance is machine-frozen
remaining_decisive_work: instantiate exact real C1 gate evidence under the frozen tournament population/lineage
apply donor-primary recurrence/source/operator/depth/support controls
apply unified rare/common biology preservation requirement
apply transfer/abstention and shortcut falsifiers

C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED.role: shared state plus explicit broad/mesoscale relational biology
C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED.dependency: C1 plus corrected relational replay viability
historical_support: TD57B prospective 24/24 PASS across two panels, HVS/NPH52/SEA-AD, donor splits and halves.
TD57C prospective fine nearest-third FAIL; hard fine-locality is not qualified.
TD59 prospective nearest-half mesoscale 24/24 PASS; nearest-half is a pilot bracket, not a production constant.
C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED.current_interpretive_constraint: Historical evidence supports broad/mesoscale relational biology but current target authority was suspended by the corrected-substrate mapping defect.
remaining_decisive_work: consume audited PR310 corrected replay only
if replay keeps C2 active, run C1 inheritance plus R1-R4 and unified rare/common preservation
if replay FAIL eliminates C2, do not rescue with downstream multimodal/regulatory evidence
if replay NOT_ESTIMABLE, keep C2 unresolved rather than failed

C3_QUERY_MEASURED.role: query-conditioned measured contextual biological state block
historical_support: R5 established the correct rich-teacher / poorer-student scientific question and structured target semantics.
Local contextual candidate work demonstrated monotonic evidence convergence, singleton-mask validity, query-self leakage sensitivity and resistance to destructive trajectory effects.
Query-information guard and lineage machinery are already part of the qualified tournament scaffold.
remaining_decisive_work: execute exact C3 G1-G8,G10-G12 plus Q1-Q8 receipts on the frozen real tournament surface
prove increment beyond q-count-only, q-address-only, query-agnostic, wrong-q and technical+q controls
apply unified rare/common biology preservation, donor/source transfer and support/abstention
do_not_repeat: local exploratory candidate search unless frozen C3 fails

C6_SHARED_QUERY_COMPOSITE.role: shared + query portfolio/fused implementation without relational constraint
C6_SHARED_QUERY_COMPOSITE.dependency: C1 and C3 must both qualify
historical_support: Prospectively added before corrected replay outcomes to close the C1+C3 factorial cell and prevent post-hoc redefinition.
remaining_decisive_work: inherit every applicable C1 and C3 gate without compensation
run C6_INCREMENT_OVER_C1_C3 prospectively
verify fusion preserves both shared and query biology including rare/common regimes
verify no transfer, shortcut, coverage or uncertainty-separation regression
C6_SHARED_QUERY_COMPOSITE.synthetic_note: Existing V79 C6 extension binds falsifiers but does not provide planted truth for the biological C6 increment unless separately prospectively planted.

C4_STRUCTURED_COMPOSITE.dependency: C2 and C3, with C1 inherited through C2
historical_support: Prospectively defined incumbent composite hypothesis; no constituent may compensate for another failing or remaining unresolved.
remaining_decisive_work: only if C2 remains active and C3 qualifies, inherit the union of all constituent gates
compare relational increment against C6 rather than rewarding component count
run C4_INCREMENT_OVER_CONSTITUENTS with donor-primary estimands
verify no loss of rare/common biology, transfer, support or uncertainty calibration
do_not_repeat: allow C4 to rescue failed C2 or C3
treat larger composite as automatically superior

C5_REGULATORY_SPECIALIST.dependency: independent specialist qualification; cannot rescue foundation failure
historical_support: Stage75F/SCENIC+ supplies regulatory-program and motif evidence.
Stage73R controls show graph topology itself is not yet specifically qualified: graph beat no-graph but did not beat target-shuffled/STRING controls.
PR311 Stage75 tail work supplies donor-recurrent STAT1/SPI1-priority biological leads but not causal or target-selection authority.
remaining_decisive_work: apply G1-G5,G10-G12 and M1-M4 under specialist rules
use same-nucleus GSE214979 after RNA target/program freeze to classify regulatory increments as recoverable, stochastic or teacher-private
use Morabito donor-level recurrence and SCENIC+/motif evidence only within their claim boundaries
retain causal claim false until perturbational evidence qualifies it
do_not_repeat: use C5 to rescue foundation failure

cross_cutting_gates_added_by_current_int.rare_common_preservation: Every active foundation block must preserve reproducible rare as well as common biology relevant to its scope; rarity is not a separate candidate family.
cross_cutting_gates_added_by_current_int.source_operator_decomposition: Program identity, source prevalence/amplitude and observation support remain separate.
cross_cutting_gates_added_by_current_int.multimodal_reconciliation: Post-freeze GSE214979/Morabito/SCENIC evidence characterizes/falsifies biological interpretation and teacher recoverability; it does not retrospectively choose the RNA target.
cross_cutting_gates_added_by_current_int.portfolio_complementarity: Surviving blocks are tested for non-redundant lawful biological information and destructive interference before portfolio freeze.

non_authority_statement: This ledger inventories evidence and remaining work; it grants no new execution, target selection, representation, TD60, Stage4 or training authority.
